question: What has been imparted to the addressed one regarding the practice of the soul?
premises: An address is made to Bhairavī.
This practice of the soul is indicated.
That practice has been told to the addressed one.
inference: The practice of the soul has been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: Details of the practice not repeated here.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
